title: Command Center
subtitle: Read-only view into EVE's local Company.OS read model. No fake data, no direct write path.

blocked.title: Read model unavailable
blocked.description: Start EVE through start_eve or set the Company.OS root so the app can read the local agent event ledger.
blocked.electronBridgeRequired: Command Center reads local Company.OS files through the Electron app process. This local bridge path is not available in browser WebUI mode.

errors.loadFailed: Command Center could not be loaded.

statusSurface.label: System state
statusSurface.description: Reads the public Command EVE status contract. No mutation, no Plane writes.
statusSurface.checkRequiredDescription: EVE could not fully prove the local status.

board.description: Board view from the same local read model. No mutation, no dispatcher, no auto-decompose.

marketingBoard.description: Hermes-native Kanban view for Command EVE Marketing. The app reads the local kanban.db, writes local cards and moves only with audit receipts, and checks dispatches through NL-5 before any worker could start.
marketingBoard.emptyColumn: No marketing cards in this lane.

blocked.title: Marketing Board not initialized yet
blocked.description: Hermes Kanban is ready, but the local marketing board database has not been created yet.

create.note: Creates exactly one local marketing card and one append-only audit event. No dispatcher, no auto-decompose, no workers.
create.title: New post

action.failed: Card action could not be recorded.

comment.title: Record comment

dispatch.ready: Dispatch plan is ready, but still waits for controller approval.
dispatch.blocked: Dispatch was blocked before Hermes could spawn.

proof.note: Creates exactly one local proof card and one append-only audit event. No workers are started.
proof.failed: Proof card could not be created.

crmOverlay.description: Local CRM-ready sales overlay for companies, contacts, and deals. No cloud sync, no bulk imports, no outreach automation.
